scripts.pack:lin: npm run clean:dist && electron-builder --linux --x64 -p never && export SNAP_FILE=$(realpath ./dist/localpass_*.snap) && unsquashfs -d ./dist/tmp-snap/ $SNAP_FILE && mkdir -p ./dist/tmp-snap/meta/polkit/ && cp ./resources/com.localpass.desktop.policy  ./dist/tmp-snap/meta/polkit/polkit.com.localpass.desktop.policy && rm $SNAP_FILE && snap pack --compression=lzo ./dist/tmp-snap/ && mv ./*.snap ./dist/ && rm -rf ./dist/tmp-snap/ && cp ./resources/com.localpass.desktop.desktop ./dist/linux-unpacked/resources && cp -r ./resources/icons ./dist/linux-unpacked/resources && tar -czvf ./dist/localpass_desktop_x64.tar.gz -C ./dist/linux-unpacked/ .
scripts.pack:lin:arm64: npm run clean:dist && electron-builder --linux --arm64 -p never && export SNAP_FILE=$(realpath ./dist/localpass_*.snap) && unsquashfs -d ./dist/tmp-snap/ $SNAP_FILE && mkdir -p ./dist/tmp-snap/meta/polkit/ && cp ./resources/com.localpass.desktop.policy  ./dist/tmp-snap/meta/polkit/polkit.com.localpass.desktop.policy && rm $SNAP_FILE && snap pack --compression=lzo ./dist/tmp-snap/ && mv ./*.snap ./dist/ && rm -rf ./dist/tmp-snap/ && cp ./resources/com.localpass.desktop.desktop ./dist/linux-arm64-unpacked/resources && cp -r ./resources/icons ./dist/linux-arm64-unpacked/resources && tar -czvf ./dist/localpass_desktop_arm64.tar.gz -C ./dist/linux-arm64-unpacked/ .

scripts.pack:mac:arm64: npm run clean:dist && npm run build:macos-extension:mac && electron-builder --mac --arm64 -p never
scripts.pack:mac:beta: npm run clean:dist && npm run update:beta && npm run build:macos-extension:beta:mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.beta.json --mac --universal -p never
